justification: noise channel step: called as `noise = ...` beside the sq1/sq2/wave steppers, gated by GB_APU_REGS.noiseLeft/noiseRight
noise channel state: one of the four 0x50-byte channel structs (D_8122C798/C7E8/C838/C888) stepped by the sq1/sq2/wave/noise functions
shared type of the four GB APU channel states (D_8122C798/C7E8/C838/C888); fields are envelope/timer/frequency per channel
sq1 channel step: `sq1 = func_81207774()` in the mixer, gated by GB_APU_REGS.sq1Left/Right; steps D_8122C798
sq2 channel step: `sq2 = func_81207A60()` in the mixer, gated by GB_APU_REGS.sq2Left/Right; steps D_8122C7E8
wave channel step: `wave = func_81207C5C()` in the mixer, gated by GB_APU_REGS.waveLeft/Right; steps D_8122C838 with wave-table indexing
duty/volume-code -> 0x7F lookup switch (arg0 = duty 0-3/6/7, arg1 = volume code), output of every channel stepper
writes GB APU registers 0x10-0x26 into D_8120EA70 (GB_APU_REGS) and updates the channel states; 0x26 = NR52 power
wave period from frequency code: 65536/(0x800 - x) scaled by D_8120EAC0 - the GB wave channel period formula (2048-x)
square 1 channel state (GbAudioChannel, 0x50 bytes), stepped by GbAudio_StepSquare1
square 2 channel state (GbAudioChannel, 0x50 bytes), stepped by GbAudio_StepSquare2
wave channel state (GbAudioChannel, 0x50 bytes), stepped by GbAudio_StepWave
0x2580-byte GbApuWrite queue ({time,reg,value}), consumed in order in the mixer loop via GbAudio_WriteReg
